text: I can't see the cause from a screenshot (the ANR trace is only saved if you tap 'Close app'; if it happens again tap Close app and the next Diagnostics report carries the main-thread trace). Likely load: the +EV tab redraws every 2 s from the engine while the download runs. Mitigation in the next build: while an update is downloading the phone reads the engine's status every 8 s instead of 2 s. v0.114.22 (live-score fix, advice ages, PropLine list kept across restarts) is out now; v0.114.23 follows with the PropLine changes and this.
